title: The Mughal Siege Around Banda Singh

blocks.text: The siege strategy depends on vakils, inducements, food, and promises as much as on direct courage, with the enemy pressing for a fixed residence, regular submission, and visible surrender from Banda.
The offers are broad enough to sound plausible, which is precisely why they become dangerous to men already worn down by encirclement.
Fixed residence is the anchor because the page’s diplomacy tries to turn a roaming war-leader into a contained subordinate.
